title: advance_tips issues one DELETE per parent in a loop
description: O(P) STATEMENTS IN TRANSACTION — advance_tips (sqlite_storage.rs:198) iterates parent_ids and issues one DELETE FROM group_tips ... WHERE tip_id=? per parent inside a single transaction. For normal single-parent appends this is fine, but CRDT reconcile can produce multi-parent merges; each parent requires a separate prepared statement execution. Fix: use DELETE ... WHERE tip_id IN (?, ?, ...) with a dynamically bound list, reducing the loop to a single statement regardless of parent count.
